“…!”

“How… how did you know?”

[P60]

[P61]
It was like turning on the TV one day out of boredom and finding a broadcast channel throwing a wet-dream party for me.

[P62]

[P63]
“Taishan. Bring that bastard here right now.”

[P64]

[P65]
“I’m really sorry to say this, but Taishan’s stronger than I am.”

[P66]
“Bring him here, no matter what!”

[P67]
“Come on, Captain. You know he tears people apart with both hands.”

[P68]
“I can tear you apart with one.”

[P69]
“Ah. Aah.”

[P70]

[P71]
“Young Master Jin. Don’t take it so hard.”

[P72]

[P73]

[P74]
“I told you it’s fine.”

[P75]
“What’s fine? Have you ever been in a situation like mine?”

[P76]

[P77]
“Of course not. I had it cut off a long time ago.”

[P78]
“…”

[P79]

[P80]
“Okay, I get it. I get it, so please stop.”

[P81]

[P82]
“I was going to stop anyway. I’m busy, too. I only came to hand over the item I was asked to deliver.”

[P83]

[P84]
The mysterious place the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord had told me about in his final moments.

[P85]
The item he’d said to find there.

[P86]
“This is…”

[P87]
“It’s an iron chest, as you can see. I don’t know what’s inside or who left it there, though.”

[P88]
“You didn’t open it?”

[P89]
“Of course not. I promised you I wouldn’t.”

[P90]
Hong Jin shrugged and added with a smile, “Besides, I wasn’t sure I could open it.”

[P91]

*Ding.*

>
> New Item acquired. Would you like to appraise the Item and view its information?

[P95]
> **System**
>
> **Item Window**
>
> **Very Sturdy Iron Chest**
>
> **Grade:** Peak  
> **Restriction:** None  
> **Description:** An iron chest made by mixing in a small amount of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron. Naturally, it’s incredibly durable—perfect for use as a shield or for storing precious belongings.

[P96]
I read the text quickly and swallowed a dry laugh.

[P97]
*Seriously? Even if it’s only a little, why use Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron in an iron chest…?*

[P98]
Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron was incredibly rare—and filthy expensive to match.

[P99]
If a reasonably well-known smith used even four nyang of it to forge a weapon, people would call it a fine sword. Use any more than that, and foul-tempered masters with a habit of spitting would descend on it like A-Gwi.

[P100]

[P101]
There weren’t many people crazy and rich enough to mix Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into an iron chest that was nothing more than a storage box.

[P102]
Of course…

[P103]
*I can think of one right away.*

[P104]
I gave a bitter smile and ran my hand over the chest.

[P105]
As if to prove it had been buried deep underground, its surface was damp, and patches of soil that hadn’t been brushed off gave off a strong earthy smell.

[P106]
*What could it be? What did you want to hide so badly?*

[P107]
I was thinking of the chest’s former owner, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, when Hong Jin rose to his feet with a wink.

[P108]
“I’ll get going. I’d only be in your way if I stayed.”

[P109]

[P110]

[P111]
“What…?”

[P113]
His one and only friend.

[P114]

[P115]
“Tell him I feel the same way.”

[P116]

[P117]
*Inventory open. Summon.*

[P118]
*Ding.*

[P119]

White Flame.

[P121]
My personal weapon, a divine weapon forged by the world’s greatest smith after a year of arduous work.

[P122]
And the key—the physical kind—to that tightly locked iron chest and its five padlocks.

[P123]
“Let’s see what you were so determined to keep hidden.”

[P124]
I murmured, then brought the spearhead down without hesitation.

[P125]
*Slice.*

[P126]
A flash of light, and the metal split apart.

[P127]

*This is…*

A dozen or so bamboo slips, so old they were practically rotting away.

[P131]

[P132]
*What is this?*

[P133]
The moment I saw them, an inexplicable shiver ran down my spine.

[P134]
These were the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s—or, to put it another way, what he’d left behind.

[P135]
Surely they held something that couldn’t be measured by weight or shape alone. Something more valuable than gold and more dangerous than gunpowder.

[P136]
It didn’t take long for me to realize my instinct was right.

[P137]
No—it took only moments.

[P138]
*Rustle.*

[P139]

[P140]
“…!”

[P141]

[P142]

[P143]
“Um, Captain. I don’t think I can bring him…”

[P144]

[P145]

[P146]

[P147]
“What?”

[P148]

[P149]
“…!”
